item.title: PGX25 0.9 (72)
item.description:
• First beta.
  • Seshes: every version and stem of a song in one place, with Stem Mode.
  • Finished songs and albums.
  • Release: visualizer videos (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) with real spectrum bars and key colours.
  • Post planner with on-device AI captions and reminders.
  • Optional: visuals react to any audio playing on your Mac.
  • Updates install themselves from now on.
